question: On which sacred occasion should special offerings be made to Gaṇapati?
premises: The time is the month of Bhādrapada
The time is the bright fortnight's fourth day
inference: The fourth day of the bright fortnight in Bhādrapada, Gaṇapati's birthday, is the prescribed occasion
uncertainties: śuklāyāñ shows a non-standard locative ending
plain_english: In the month of Bhādrapada, on the fourth day of the bright fortnight, on my birthday...
